findings.claim: The assessment omits the CLI from its credential propagation analysis, although the phase goals explicitly require tracing long-lived credential copies through it.
findings.evidence: The goals require: ‘Include CLI, HTTP, MCP and the optional embedding client when tracing long-lived credential copies.’ The assessment instead says: ‘Trace request-time use in REST, AG-UI, ACP, both MCP transports, model discovery and the optional embedding client,’ with no corresponding CLI assessment or identified gap.
findings.suggested_fix: Assess which CLI commands load or retain credentials and identify whether they must observe credential changes or require separate verification.
findings.follow_up: The independent reviewer checked the revised assessment and scenario 1 against src/main.rs and src/cli/setup.rs and confirmed the warning was resolved.
